name: ToggleSwitch
description: `ToggleSwitch` is a form-associated binary switch with small and medium sizes.

props.name: buttonLabelOff
props.description: Text shown when the switch is off. Only customize it when there is a more specific label for the context.

props.name: buttonLabelOn
props.description: Text shown when the switch is on. Only customize it when there is a more specific label for the context.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the switch's value is being calculated. A loading switch shows a spinner and does not accept input.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Text describing what is loading, announced to assistive technology after `loadingLabelDelay`.

props.name: loadingLabelDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before `loadingLabel` is announced while loading.

props.name: statusLabelPosition
props.description:
Whether the "on" and "off" status labels appear before or after the switch.
Only change this when the switch's alignment needs to be adjusted.
